text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're showing "The World of Carpets" 
on TV. Sounds interesting~. Later this 
evening, huh...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Until then, I guess I'll pass the time 
watching the dramas and reading the books 
everyone recommended."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*... That was such a good story~ 
Well, guess it's time for a bath—
